summary_policy: Shared prompt requests 3–5 paragraphs, approximately 220–350 words if supported by the source, with context, key arguments and practical implications. Short material stays proportional; no padding or new facts. Existing saved summaries change only when regenerated. Real AI output length is not verified with the user account.
regeneration: Explicit editorial action. Reuses the stored source, deduplicates an active job, preserves old summary and note until valid success, refreshes the item and preserves unsaved comments. A failure keeps previous material, notifies editors/admins and re-enables the action. Automatic publication processing remains active.
transcript_policy: Source remains stored for processing and authorized editing/API access. The transcript accordion is removed from the item view for all roles.
frameworks_layout: Full width, wrapping tags matching concepts; norms retain their own full-width section.
limitations: Providers and source material simulated in disposable loopback WordPress; no real API account or remote deployment tested.
No new full security audit, load test, SonarQube, ZAP or complete historical workflow run. Axe is automated checking, not a full manual WCAG audit.
temporary_environment_cleanup: completed; isolated ascla_release1110 containers, volumes, test users, source cache and private environment/access files removed
simulation_metrics_scope: Fixture lifecycle including cache priming; the successful browser rerun reused the primed complete transcript. One simulated create and two polls in total; regeneration made no new transcript request.
visual_review: Capturas de marcos en escritorio claro y móvil oscuro, y resumen ampliado en móvil claro revisadas: etiquetas adaptables, tarjetas completas y párrafos legibles.
